trialSpd2Supplements.note: Ability-trial (能力試験/能力審査) speed supplements for debut horses that had no race-based spd2. Each value is the measured trial time expressed on the production spd2 yardstick: par = median of all pool race times at the same (track, surface, distance) dated strictly before the trial date (pool = the same corpus + refetched runs used for this file, via shadow_v8.build_speed_adjusted); raw = trial time - par; when the trial day has a variant for (track, surface) the value is variant-adjusted exactly like race runs, otherwise the raw residual is used and the form is recorded per horse. spd2_recent = spd2_best = the single trial value. Elo is never derived from trials; elo fields of these entries are unchanged.
sources: Kawasaki trials: nankankeiba.com official trial lists (shiken_list), Sonoda trials: sonoda-himeji.jp official ability-exam results, Nagoya trials: Nagoya Keiba official 能力審査成績表 PDFs (mirrored by Aichi Owners Association).
